name: Background Jobs & Scheduling
description: Background Jobs & Scheduling standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-JOB applies.

rules.title: Make jobs idempotent and restartable
rules.detail: A retry, worker restart or duplicate schedule must not create duplicate business effects; persist checkpoints for long work.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make jobs idempotent and restartable.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make jobs idempotent and restartable.

rules.title: Define retry, backoff and terminal failure behavior
rules.detail: Classify retryable failures, cap attempts and route terminal failures to alert/manual recovery or dead-letter handling.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define retry, backoff and terminal failure behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define retry, backoff and terminal failure behavior.

rules.title: Prevent overlapping execution when unsafe
rules.detail: Use scheduler guarantees, durable locks or partitioning when the same job instance must not run concurrently.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent overlapping execution when unsafe.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent overlapping execution when unsafe.

rules.title: Propagate correlation and business identifiers
rules.detail: Job executions record job ID, trigger, attempt and relevant business correlation for support and audit.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Propagate correlation and business identifiers.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Propagate correlation and business identifiers.

rules.title: Bound work per execution
rules.detail: Batch/paginate large datasets and define timeout/cancellation so one job cannot monopolize workers indefinitely.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Bound work per execution.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Bound work per execution.

rules.title: Make schedules and timezone semantics explicit
rules.detail: Use a named timezone or UTC and document DST behavior for calendar-based jobs.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make schedules and timezone semantics explicit.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make schedules and timezone semantics explicit.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-JOB applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Background Jobs & Scheduling to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Background Jobs & Scheduling is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Background Jobs & Scheduling failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
